title: FEAT-157 ordinary chat market selection
description: Independent unreleased Native IPC and durable snapshot source. Overall FEAT-157 impact breaking; source-only local candidate, no Host route or execution grant. External refs preserve existing authorities.

commands.requiredPermission: chat permissions; connector.use only for nonempty selection

selection_digest.encoding: ASCII; actual LF line endings; lowercase hexadecimal digest
lines: each sorted installationId + ASCII SPACE + decimal revision + ASCII SPACE + decimal generation

semantics.acceptedReplay: same scope and same immutable intent returns original receipt without prepare/bind/Runtime work; changed intent conflicts; complete content/target/model/selection identity is compared, selectionDigest alone is insufficient
semantics.emptySelection: explicit no market tools; never inherits previous or global market capability
semantics.unqualifiedNonempty: reject execution_unavailable before durable acceptance; do not trim or silently fall back
semantics.unknownOutcome: reuse original operation and query/replay only; do not generate replacement operation
semantics.rollback: feature-off readers must skip connector-aware outboxes; old entry points must not execute connector snapshots
semantics.authority: Native current scope and normal chat permissions; selection and digest do not grant authority
semantics.unqualifiedProvider: reject all new submissions before durable acceptance; no legacy dispatch fallback
semantics.legacyCollision: If the submission operation already belongs to a legacy outbox/turn/model record and lacks a market snapshot, return request_conflict; never adopt or relabel an existing legacy operation.
